description:
Update loop.ex to use SessionManager instead of MessageLog, and call
SessionManager.build_session_context/1 to produce the message list for each LLM call.

This ticket is the companion to "Migrate Session.State from MessageLog to SessionManager"
and must land at the same time (the codebase does not compile with only one).

## Key change in stream_turn/3 (loop.ex ~line 156)

Before:
  context = %AIContext{
    system_prompt: state.system_prompt,
    messages: MessageLog.to_list(messages),
    tools: Enum.map(state.tools, &agent_tool_to_ai_tool/1)
  }

After:
  session_ctx = SessionManager.build_session_context(state.session_manager)
  context = %AIContext{
    system_prompt: state.system_prompt,
    messages: session_ctx.messages,
    tools: Enum.map(state.tools, &agent_tool_to_ai_tool/1)
  }

NOTE: state.session_manager is the SessionManager being threaded through the
loop recursion (see below) — not state from the Session GenServer.

## Loop state threading

Currently loop/6 and its helpers thread a local `messages :: MessageLog.t()` through
recursion. Replace with `session_manager :: SessionManager.t()`.

Every place that was:
  MessageLog.push(messages, assistant)         ->  SessionManager.append_message(sm, assistant)
  MessageLog.append_many(updated, tool_results) -> sequential append_message calls
  MessageLog.append_many(messages, drained)    -> sequential append_message calls

## Run completion cast

Change from:
  GenServer.cast(session, {:run_complete, messages, reason})
To:
  GenServer.cast(session, {:run_complete, session_manager, reason})

AgentEnd event currently carries messages: MessageLog.to_list(messages).
Change to: SessionManager.get_branch(session_manager) |> Enum.map(& &1.message)
but filter to only MessageEntry nodes first.

## Remove MessageLog alias

Remove `alias OctoPi.Agent.MessageLog` from loop.ex once migration is complete.

## Tests

Run mix test apps/octo_pi_agent/ — all existing tests must pass.
If any test directly inspects the messages list from AgentEnd or run_complete,
update assertions to match the new SessionEntry-based structure.
title: Migrate Loop to build_session_context
